title: BluWave Boat Rental
specs: Operate within Tampa Bay area from Egmont Key to Skyway Bridge and Siesta Key
Boats equipped with GPS and depth finders
Charters include knowledgeable captains with marine ecology and navigation expertise
At least 2 years of legitimate boating experience and 200 hours at helm
Proof of N.A.S.B.L.A. or equivalent boater’s safety course required if born after Jan 1, 1988
Valid state or federal photo ID required
Major credit card required for payment, fuel, and $500 damage deposit
Operators must be sober during rental, zero tolerance for alcohol

options.name: Boat Rental
options.detail: Luxury boat rental for experienced boaters, up to 6 people

options.name: Custom Boat Charter
options.detail: Private boat charter with captain for up to 6 passengers

includes: Fuel included, boats delivered full and refueling service available for $10 fee
Charts of the area and full orientation included
GPS navigation systems with depth finders on every boat
blurb: Guests rent luxury boats for private use or book private charters with a captain. Rentals require experience and a safety certificate. Charters are customizable for tours, celebrations, or sightseeing with a captain onboard.
extraNote: Cancellations result in gift card with no expiration, no refunds except for named storms · Weather cancellations by operator result in full gift card; renter weather cancellations get gift card or reschedule · Damage responsibility is on renter; $500 deposit held on credit card for up to 7 days · Orientation required before rental, 15-30 minutes included in rental time · North Coquina boat ramp on Anna Maria Island
